build_coco_caption_data: build the COCO 2014 caption dataset by downloading and extracting dataset_coco.tgz to the data path
build_coco_images: build the COCO 2014 image dataset by downloading train, val, and test 2014 zip files
check_data_built: check if the COCO 2014 caption or image data has already been built using build_data.built
remove_outdated_data: remove an older version of the COCO 2014 data directory using build_data.remove_dir
mark_data_done: mark the COCO 2014 caption or image data as built using build_data.mark_done
